stem: In paragraphs 7 through 13, which detail best supports the key idea that Carol is determined to explore the special qualities of the book?

options.label: A
options.text: Carol decides to talk about the most recent book she has borrowed.

options.label: B
options.text: Carol hopes that she will be permitted to return to the library.

options.label: C
options.text: Carol avoids the book when she arrives at the library.

options.label: D
options.text: Carol rereads the section that she believes has changed.
